title: Bakuon!! no Kobeya
justification: AniList 99841 (SPECIAL, 4 episode(s) from 2016-08-04) is AniDB 11253's special(s) S1-S4, aired 2016-08-24 to 2016-11-18. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 21197, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 11253. overlay/11253.json places S1-S4 on TVDB 304987 0x2-0x5 'Bakuon's Closet Shorts Vol. 1-4', which carry the same titles on the same dates.
